pencil.definition: A writing or drawing tool with a solid core that leaves marks on paper.
pencil.exampleUsage: Rami writes notes with a pencil.

pen.definition: A tool that uses ink for writing or drawing.
pen.exampleUsage: Rami signs the form with a pen.

eraser.definition: An object used to remove pencil marks.
eraser.exampleUsage: Rami removes a pencil mark with an eraser.

ruler.definition: A straight tool used to measure distances or draw straight lines.
ruler.exampleUsage: Rami draws a straight line with a ruler.

marker.definition: A pen with a broad or felt tip, used to make clear marks.
marker.exampleUsage: The teacher writes on the board with a marker.

crayon.definition: A stick of coloured wax used for drawing.
crayon.exampleUsage: Rami uses a crayon for the colour activity.

colored-pencil.definition: A pencil with a coloured core used for drawing.
colored-pencil.exampleUsage: Rami colours the drawing with a colored pencil.

highlighter.definition: A pen with bright translucent ink used to mark important text.
highlighter.exampleUsage: Rami marks an important sentence with a highlighter.

pencil-sharpener.definition: A tool used to make the point of a pencil sharp.
pencil-sharpener.exampleUsage: Rami uses a pencil sharpener before class.

pencil-case.definition: A small container or pouch for pens, pencils and similar items.
pencil-case.exampleUsage: Rami keeps his pens in a pencil case.

notebook.definition: A book of pages used for writing notes.
notebook.exampleUsage: Rami writes a new word in his notebook.

textbook.definition: A book that teaches a particular subject.

workbook.definition: A book containing exercises for a learner to complete.
workbook.exampleUsage: Rami completes an exercise in his workbook.

folder.definition: A cover or container for holding loose papers.
folder.exampleUsage: Rami puts the handout in a folder.

binder.definition: A cover with rings or another mechanism for holding loose pages.
binder.exampleUsage: Rami adds the pages to his binder.

sheet-of-paper.exampleUsage: Rami takes a sheet of paper for notes.

sticky-note.definition: A small piece of paper with adhesive on one part for temporary notes.
sticky-note.exampleUsage: Rami puts a sticky note on the folder.

index-card.definition: A small stiff card used for notes or organised information.
index-card.exampleUsage: Rami writes a word on an index card.

dictionary.definition: A reference work explaining words, often with spelling and pronunciation.
dictionary.exampleUsage: Rami checks a word in the dictionary.

encyclopedia.definition: A reference work containing information on many subjects or a particular subject.
encyclopedia.exampleUsage: Rami reads about planets in an encyclopedia.

desk.definition: A table used for writing, study or office work.
desk.exampleUsage: Rami puts his notebook on the desk.

chair.definition: A seat for one person, usually with a back.
chair.exampleUsage: Rami sits on a chair during class.

whiteboard.definition: A smooth white board used for writing with erasable markers.
whiteboard.exampleUsage: The teacher writes a word on the whiteboard.

projector.definition: A device that casts an image onto a screen or other surface.
projector.exampleUsage: The teacher uses a projector for the slides.

screen.definition: A surface on which projected images appear; here a projection screen.
screen.exampleUsage: The slides appear on the screen.

globe.definition: A spherical model of the Earth.
globe.exampleUsage: Rami finds Egypt on the globe.

shelf.definition: A horizontal surface used for holding books or other objects.
shelf.exampleUsage: Rami puts the dictionary on a shelf.

locker.definition: A small storage cupboard that can be locked.
locker.exampleUsage: Rami stores his bag in a locker.

bulletin-board.definition: A board used to display notices and other information.
bulletin-board.exampleUsage: Rami checks the notice on the bulletin board.

backpack.definition: A bag carried on the back using shoulder straps.
backpack.exampleUsage: Rami carries his books in a backpack.

scissors.definition: A cutting tool with two blades joined so they move against each other.

glue-stick.definition: A tube containing solid adhesive that is rubbed onto a surface.
glue-stick.exampleUsage: Rami attaches paper with a glue stick.

tape.definition: A narrow adhesive strip used to attach things; here sticky tape.
tape.exampleUsage: Rami fastens the paper with tape.

stapler.definition: A tool that joins papers using small metal staples.
stapler.exampleUsage: Rami joins the pages with a stapler.

paper-clip.definition: A small bent piece of wire or similar clip used to hold papers together.
paper-clip.exampleUsage: Rami holds two pages together with a paper clip.

rubber-band.definition: An elastic loop used to hold things together.
rubber-band.exampleUsage: Rami puts a rubber band around the cards.

thumbtack.definition: A short pin with a broad head used to attach paper to a board.
thumbtack.exampleUsage: Rami pins a notice with a thumbtack.

calculator.definition: A device or program used for numerical calculations.
calculator.exampleUsage: Rami checks the total with a calculator.

compass.definition: A two-legged drawing instrument used to draw circles or arcs.
compass.exampleUsage: Rami draws a circle with a compass.

computer.definition: An electronic device that processes information and runs programs.
computer.exampleUsage: Rami uses a computer for the lesson.

laptop.definition: A portable computer with a screen that folds over its keyboard.
laptop.exampleUsage: Rami brings his laptop to class.

tablet.definition: A portable computer controlled mainly through a touchscreen.
tablet.exampleUsage: Rami opens the exercise on a tablet.

keyboard.definition: A set of keys used to enter information into a computer.
keyboard.exampleUsage: Rami types a sentence on the keyboard.

mouse.definition: A handheld computer input device used to move a pointer and select items.
mouse.exampleUsage: Rami selects the file with a mouse.

printer.definition: A machine that produces text or images on paper.
printer.exampleUsage: Rami collects the page from the printer.

usb-drive.definition: A small portable data-storage device that connects through a USB port.
usb-drive.exampleUsage: Rami saves his file on a USB drive.

headphones.definition: A pair of devices worn over or in the ears for listening to sound.
headphones.exampleUsage: Rami uses headphones for the listening exercise.

projector-remote.definition: A handheld remote used to control a projector or its presentation, depending on the equipment.
projector-remote.arabicTranslation: جهاز تحكم عن بُعد لجهاز العرض
projector-remote.exampleUsage: The teacher uses the projector remote to change the display.

charger.definition: A device supplying electrical power to recharge a battery.
charger.exampleUsage: Rami connects his laptop to its charger.

teacher.definition: A person whose work is to help others learn.

student.definition: A person studying at a school, college or other course.
student.exampleUsage: Rami is a student in an adult evening class.

principal.definition: The person in charge of a school; here the head of the school.

librarian.definition: A person who works professionally with library materials and services.
librarian.exampleUsage: The librarian helps Rami find a book.

janitor.definition: A person responsible for cleaning and basic care of a building.

school-nurse.definition: A nurse who supports health needs in a school.
school-nurse.exampleUsage: The school nurse speaks with a parent.

substitute-teacher.definition: A teacher who temporarily takes another teacher’s place.
substitute-teacher.exampleUsage: A substitute teacher leads today’s class.

teaching-assistant.definition: A person who helps a teacher with lessons and learners.
teaching-assistant.exampleUsage: The teaching assistant hands out the worksheets.

counselor.definition: A trained person who helps people discuss difficulties or make decisions.
counselor.exampleUsage: The counselor discusses course choices with Rami.

security-guard.definition: A person employed to protect people or property at a place.
security-guard.exampleUsage: The security guard checks the entrance.

homework.definition: Work that a teacher asks a learner to do outside class.
homework.exampleUsage: Rami finishes his homework at home.

test.definition: A task or set of questions used to check knowledge or ability.

recess.definition: A short break between school lessons, especially in American English.
recess.exampleUsage: The school notice gives the recess times.

bell.definition: A hollow metal object that makes a ringing sound when struck.

grade.definition: A mark or rating given for schoolwork or a test; here an assessment result.
grade.exampleUsage: Rami receives a grade for his test.

uniform.definition: A set of clothes worn to identify members of a school or organisation.
uniform.exampleUsage: The notice describes the school uniform.
